An alcohol rash is ` [Highlight start] a skin reaction—such as flushing, hives, or red bumps—that happens after drinking alcohol or due to alcohol-related health effects [Highlight end] ` . It usually stems from alcohol intolerance, an allergy to drink ingredients, or a flare-up of an underlying skin condition rather than a true allergy to ethanol itself.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX4znQizJvGclufLPGDRg0g9TMDQPY2dlCt5TFUbW5CmxzJaRFwbqfH-76z19Dxc589r0lx_VXXEOx387r5i2dZsZ0luO8mTEFMIY_TRwp_n-Pa3Wq0PU5zR7lH_OkY2-doK5hq9V9ayLfR3ED1T-OpM8GB9bhOjk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF125bb2NXlXWiYqj-DuYXlmKsNUXEmm7Lt0m3WFD7ndsHYLClqnaks0PJRkWZ4pcaP5i4aUr8bmkJ2ZHnm_lXH7upDRbcqWbadKJixGfUdiZMCroO0ss6v0u-K0Ynra7n7GgnP-9C1W6BkB_GJktBppvx25gFDThyXpxok7kZLJxm3w3895oKIuArgqeCjXa-tImeQCmF)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_QX2c0JRG31Gi9ngc7w-SHdPoXrZ_0qVeE28CvJIz92TFBuGf3fNK9A_673Souf29xoLSagkUXl3ddWd2Z5lsDuo5o-wySLeB9Wvsd8gOTKrcmEt61FwUziJ1Yg56305Ra2RdX7E81_PNy8Qes82is7Of9EWDUpysjtAJUA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-EbBBJgTq4AB4oz-VwfiFvJoVSSxTMGkUk7XVl3HxHziUEk3I0xPp8XcHOgV-gPmFqILP1DS0RMhZVlc9pn-YGKWY1TYILi2h2-ICQleSSdWvAY2mp4JB_ss-HRaftuC6UFXt617a4bRWmXDfOL3P8-8FBOsvcHFsU-rm0I-YLlOw)

### Common Symptoms

- **Flushing:** Warm, red skin, most often on the face, neck, and chest.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1zaORh-K_LNg9bEr_yN_WzSk6gUBonTpPjhv4s22MnmxjhASZwLrYwtxeSJlLJKRWjMWHkhlMPxcYxlLP60lEihsVyYhDXOqqX2AD7Jxh2TG9pRMMAI2a0Xt61QWFRsHaaB8BBt8T-bzesVGJ1fNteJpS4FvzGYq3LbjG1f-lA)
- **Hives (urticaria):** Raised, red, itchy welts that may appear in one spot or spread across the body.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_QX2c0JRG31Gi9ngc7w-SHdPoXrZ_0qVeE28CvJIz92TFBuGf3fNK9A_673Souf29xoLSagkUXl3ddWd2Z5lsDuo5o-wySLeB9Wvsd8gOTKrcmEt61FwUziJ1Yg56305Ra2RdX7E81_PNy8Qes82is7Of9EWDUpysjtAJUA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX4znQizJvGclufLPGDRg0g9TMDQPY2dlCt5TFUbW5CmxzJaRFwbqfH-76z19Dxc589r0lx_VXXEOx387r5i2dZsZ0luO8mTEFMIY_TRwp_n-Pa3Wq0PU5zR7lH_OkY2-doK5hq9V9ayLfR3ED1T-OpM8GB9bhOjk)
- **Itching or irritation:** Dry, bumpy, or tingling skin.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXRzgwYR56Yk7mULtXgsIPC1aNv1P6lCy9lm7Me63cbUfCEqwbd69cdkpbGBfHDVuI37yFcJ_EHRld_SibEYGPXhUQWD0bKEBo2l1qKH5nA123vz9zWfM1rEw5B0Xe4hrwwBdDezFpqlZROi6BCaqz-ZOsA44KVG5NzDo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-EbBBJgTq4AB4oz-VwfiFvJoVSSxTMGkUk7XVl3HxHziUEk3I0xPp8XcHOgV-gPmFqILP1DS0RMhZVlc9pn-YGKWY1TYILi2h2-ICQleSSdWvAY2mp4JB_ss-HRaftuC6UFXt617a4bRWmXDfOL3P8-8FBOsvcHFsU-rm0I-YLlOw)
- **Other accompanying symptoms:** Stuffy nose, nausea, rapid heartbeat, headache, or swelling.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF125bb2NXlXWiYqj-DuYXlmKsNUXEmm7Lt0m3WFD7ndsHYLClqnaks0PJRkWZ4pcaP5i4aUr8bmkJ2ZHnm_lXH7upDRbcqWbadKJixGfUdiZMCroO0ss6v0u-K0Ynra7n7GgnP-9C1W6BkB_GJktBppvx25gFDThyXpxok7kZLJxm3w3895oKIuArgqeCjXa-tImeQCmF)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESvQEBxCJF108pN8_W4Hqhn_wMEFPuN-HNzv8X7_01pX5-PEVCtOYNAfuIwTdjtdqp5hV0pcnH_6AM0IATCVg_xaSGtas7MYci6MmdHEvUppoftjJQRfKomuB2dVQ_OXAzXGGthF3mb5gUcFh1mV1k29kJ6I3HGnUH932g9yCD0JWgah9i22My--c8uXVsWJ4sF1lQD-Ix4X5ixtTs0XYB8FGL2HGqrwJt8O41fVQDuAEwvXVvNJDfguxK6_U1PEc)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-EbBBJgTq4AB4oz-VwfiFvJoVSSxTMGkUk7XVl3HxHziUEk3I0xPp8XcHOgV-gPmFqILP1DS0RMhZVlc9pn-YGKWY1TYILi2h2-ICQleSSdWvAY2mp4JB_ss-HRaftuC6UFXt617a4bRWmXDfOL3P8-8FBOsvcHFsU-rm0I-YLlOw)

### Main Causes

- **Alcohol intolerance:** A genetic enzyme issue—most commonly involving aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH2)—prevents the body from breaking down acetaldehyde efficiently, causing flushing and histamine release. Learn more from the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF18nTXTEKRiAtlblnI7GvWsuVYAYKD7WnXFj2FNZV4zXL0uWL_7Z7jm7EmxdGSkihnR3Z0KwH8RSUhgusqGJMLWUHW3tchaIQznybVot0COqodYV454bV2MP8IaSXVMbWGmLR2zEZLvlGhO09xcayNJ4UPMUfyL7iddNRX8iRvBdYE8dfpD0fZn5UYLwfEmsjFBsxa_z1mPNPRV99CQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF18nTXTEKRiAtlblnI7GvWsuVYAYKD7WnXFj2FNZV4zXL0uWL_7Z7jm7EmxdGSkihnR3Z0KwH8RSUhgusqGJMLWUHW3tchaIQznybVot0COqodYV454bV2MP8IaSXVMbWGmLR2zEZLvlGhO09xcayNJ4UPMUfyL7iddNRX8iRvBdYE8dfpD0fZn5UYLwfEmsjFBsxa_z1mPNPRV99CQ)
- **Ingredient allergies or sensitivities:** Reactions to histamines, sulfites, grains (like wheat or barley), yeast, preservatives, or flavorings in beer, wine, or mixed drinks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX0rjRfpQR0T-fYLaK2yvN8GVw_n17ANJLJ4-1kxR3gKjLvmMDA66WTuNFM0Xfl6rinuRKmaQv7iYqBJxH0YHHoNAbE7bI6GSoA_ZMuLBblvh4F6TBjZwVcINB6OR_KMlG0yETAQUYpSBy6pA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX4znQizJvGclufLPGDRg0g9TMDQPY2dlCt5TFUbW5CmxzJaRFwbqfH-76z19Dxc589r0lx_VXXEOx387r5i2dZsZ0luO8mTEFMIY_TRwp_n-Pa3Wq0PU5zR7lH_OkY2-doK5hq9V9ayLfR3ED1T-OpM8GB9bhOjk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF125bb2NXlXWiYqj-DuYXlmKsNUXEmm7Lt0m3WFD7ndsHYLClqnaks0PJRkWZ4pcaP5i4aUr8bmkJ2ZHnm_lXH7upDRbcqWbadKJixGfUdiZMCroO0ss6v0u-K0Ynra7n7GgnP-9C1W6BkB_GJktBppvx25gFDThyXpxok7kZLJxm3w3895oKIuArgqeCjXa-tImeQCmF)
- **Flare-ups of existing skin conditions:** Alcohol can trigger or worsen rosacea, psoriasis, eczema, or seborrheic dermatitis.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_QX2c0JRG31Gi9ngc7w-SHdPoXrZ_0qVeE28CvJIz92TFBuGf3fNK9A_673Souf29xoLSagkUXl3ddWd2Z5lsDuo5o-wySLeB9Wvsd8gOTKrcmEt61FwUziJ1Yg56305Ra2RdX7E81_PNy8Qes82is7Of9EWDUpysjtAJUA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXRzgwYR56Yk7mULtXgsIPC1aNv1P6lCy9lm7Me63cbUfCEqwbd69cdkpbGBfHDVuI37yFcJ_EHRld_SibEYGPXhUQWD0bKEBo2l1qKH5nA123vz9zWfM1rEw5B0Xe4hrwwBdDezFpqlZROi6BCaqz-ZOsA44KVG5NzDo)
- **Medication interactions:** Mixing alcohol with certain drugs (such as some antibiotics or disulfiram) can trigger flushing or skin reactions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF18nTXTEKRiAtlblnI7GvWsuVYAYKD7WnXFj2FNZV4zXL0uWL_7Z7jm7EmxdGSkihnR3Z0KwH8RSUhgusqGJMLWUHW3tchaIQznybVot0COqodYV454bV2MP8IaSXVMbWGmLR2zEZLvlGhO09xcayNJ4UPMUfyL7iddNRX8iRvBdYE8dfpD0fZn5UYLwfEmsjFBsxa_z1mPNPRV99CQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXRzgwYR56Yk7mULtXgsIPC1aNv1P6lCy9lm7Me63cbUfCEqwbd69cdkpbGBfHDVuI37yFcJ_EHRld_SibEYGPXhUQWD0bKEBo2l1qKH5nA123vz9zWfM1rEw5B0Xe4hrwwBdDezFpqlZROi6BCaqz-ZOsA44KVG5NzDo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXDgu3wp7hUBCBz-JcEotng8GHX4QAB_WlYmDqUI5RjbBX99H1S1ihZn4SaNC0iR_1cG-5F1FFT9nYKxPGgi14pxH4wkZt5ZTR98F7EKvnDQBlN4g7TvdnPGyEVxQf0PmiWBf5HTxAQw)
- **Heavy or chronic drinking:** Long-term heavy use can contribute to nutritional deficiencies, liver issues, or skin infections.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXGP4wDV1TpQM5X0FpgUpayKbUXwPNK2iaS1j4SUPUap6q1li6K5FYpS1KxgGUTir3Acp0J_jyU6etco-crekaTDqMVleAMEaSoFicQC1ntMb_lXzZRCiT2My_coTBbaf3K0e2Fh-Ym2Y)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX4znQizJvGclufLPGDRg0g9TMDQPY2dlCt5TFUbW5CmxzJaRFwbqfH-76z19Dxc589r0lx_VXXEOx387r5i2dZsZ0luO8mTEFMIY_TRwp_n-Pa3Wq0PU5zR7lH_OkY2-doK5hq9V9ayLfR3ED1T-OpM8GB9bhOjk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_QX2c0JRG31Gi9ngc7w-SHdPoXrZ_0qVeE28CvJIz92TFBuGf3fNK9A_673Souf29xoLSagkUXl3ddWd2Z5lsDuo5o-wySLeB9Wvsd8gOTKrcmEt61FwUziJ1Yg56305Ra2RdX7E81_PNy8Qes82is7Of9EWDUpysjtAJUA)

### How Long It Lasts

- **Flushing and mild hives:** Often start within minutes to hours of drinking and may fade within a few hours to a day or two once alcohol clears your system.
- **Flare-ups or chronic skin issues:** Rashes linked to rosacea, psoriasis, or heavy drinking can last days, weeks, or longer if triggers continue.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX4znQizJvGclufLPGDRg0g9TMDQPY2dlCt5TFUbW5CmxzJaRFwbqfH-76z19Dxc589r0lx_VXXEOx387r5i2dZsZ0luO8mTEFMIY_TRwp_n-Pa3Wq0PU5zR7lH_OkY2-doK5hq9V9ayLfR3ED1T-OpM8GB9bhOjk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXRzgwYR56Yk7mULtXgsIPC1aNv1P6lCy9lm7Me63cbUfCEqwbd69cdkpbGBfHDVuI37yFcJ_EHRld_SibEYGPXhUQWD0bKEBo2l1qKH5nA123vz9zWfM1rEw5B0Xe4hrwwBdDezFpqlZROi6BCaqz-ZOsA44KVG5NzDo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_QX2c0JRG31Gi9ngc7w-SHdPoXrZ_0qVeE28CvJIz92TFBuGf3fNK9A_673Souf29xoLSagkUXl3ddWd2Z5lsDuo5o-wySLeB9Wvsd8gOTKrcmEt61FwUziJ1Yg56305Ra2RdX7E81_PNy8Qes82is7Of9EWDUpysjtAJUA)

### Treatment and When to Get Help

- **At-home care:** Stop drinking alcohol or avoid the specific beverage that triggered it. Cool compresses and over-the-counter antihistamines can help ease mild itching or hives after a reaction starts, though taking antihistamines before drinking is not recommended because it can mask warning signs and encourage heavier drinking.
- **Emergency care:** Seek urgent medical help immediately if a rash comes with trouble breathing, throat or tongue swelling, dizziness, severe vomiting, or a drop in blood pressure (signs of anaphylaxis).
- **Medical evaluation:** See a healthcare provider if rashes keep returning, don't clear up, or might be tied to a medication or underlying skin condition.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-EbBBJgTq4AB4oz-VwfiFvJoVSSxTMGkUk7XVl3HxHziUEk3I0xPp8XcHOgV-gPmFqILP1DS0RMhZVlc9pn-YGKWY1TYILi2h2-ICQleSSdWvAY2mp4JB_ss-HRaftuC6UFXt617a4bRWmXDfOL3P8-8FBOsvcHFsU-rm0I-YLlOw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF125bb2NXlXWiYqj-DuYXlmKsNUXEmm7Lt0m3WFD7ndsHYLClqnaks0PJRkWZ4pcaP5i4aUr8bmkJ2ZHnm_lXH7upDRbcqWbadKJixGfUdiZMCroO0ss6v0u-K0Ynra7n7GgnP-9C1W6BkB_GJktBppvx25gFDThyXpxok7kZLJxm3w3895oKIuArgqeCjXa-tImeQCmF)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXRzgwYR56Yk7mULtXgsIPC1aNv1P6lCy9lm7Me63cbUfCEqwbd69cdkpbGBfHDVuI37yFcJ_EHRld_SibEYGPXhUQWD0bKEBo2l1qKH5nA123vz9zWfM1rEw5B0Xe4hrwwBdDezFpqlZROi6BCaqz-ZOsA44KVG5NzDo)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX0rjRfpQR0T-fYLaK2yvN8GVw_n17ANJLJ4-1kxR3gKjLvmMDA66WTuNFM0Xfl6rinuRKmaQv7iYqBJxH0YHHoNAbE7bI6GSoA_ZMuLBblvh4F6TBjZwVcINB6OR_KMlG0yETAQUYpSBy6pA)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF18nTXTEKRiAtlblnI7GvWsuVYAYKD7WnXFj2FNZV4zXL0uWL_7Z7jm7EmxdGSkihnR3Z0KwH8RSUhgusqGJMLWUHW3tchaIQznybVot0COqodYV454bV2MP8IaSXVMbWGmLR2zEZLvlGhO09xcayNJ4UPMUfyL7iddNRX8iRvBdYE8dfpD0fZn5UYLwfEmsjFBsxa_z1mPNPRV99CQ)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESvQEBxCJF108pN8_W4Hqhn_wMEFPuN-HNzv8X7_01pX5-PEVCtOYNAfuIwTdjtdqp5hV0pcnH_6AM0IATCVg_xaSGtas7MYci6MmdHEvUppoftjJQRfKomuB2dVQ_OXAzXGGthF3mb5gUcFh1mV1k29kJ6I3HGnUH932g9yCD0JWgah9i22My--c8uXVsWJ4sF1lQD-Ix4X5ixtTs0XYB8FGL2HGqrwJt8O41fVQDuAEwvXVvNJDfguxK6_U1PEc)[[7]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_QX2c0JRG31Gi9ngc7w-SHdPoXrZ_0qVeE28CvJIz92TFBuGf3fNK9A_673Souf29xoLSagkUXl3ddWd2Z5lsDuo5o-wySLeB9Wvsd8gOTKrcmEt61FwUziJ1Yg56305Ra2RdX7E81_PNy8Qes82is7Of9EWDUpysjtAJUA)[[8]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1zaORh-K_LNg9bEr_yN_WzSk6gUBonTpPjhv4s22MnmxjhASZwLrYwtxeSJlLJKRWjMWHkhlMPxcYxlLP60lEihsVyYhDXOqqX2AD7Jxh2TG9pRMMAI2a0Xt61QWFRsHaaB8BBt8T-bzesVGJ1fNteJpS4FvzGYq3LbjG1f-lA)

Itching or irritation: Dry, bumpy, or tingling skin. Other accompanying symptoms: Stuffy nose, nausea, rapid heartbeat, headache, or swelling.

items.title: Main Causes
items.text: Alcohol intolerance: A genetic enzyme issue—most commonly involving aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH2)—prevents the body from breaking down acetaldehyde efficiently, causing flushing and histamine release. Learn more from the National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism. Ingredient allergies or sensitivities: Reactions to histamines, sulfites, grains (like wheat or barley), yeast, preservatives, or flavorings in beer, wine, or mixed drinks. Flare-ups of existing skin conditions: Alcohol can trigger or worsen rosacea, psoriasis, eczema, or seborrheic dermatitis. Medication interactions: Mixing alcohol with certain drugs (such as some antibiotics or disulfiram) can trigger flushing or skin reactions. Heavy or chronic drinking: Long-term heavy use can contribute to nutritional deficiencies, liver issues, or skin infections.

items.title: How Long It Lasts
items.text: Flushing and mild hives: Often start within minutes to hours of drinking and may fade within a few hours to a day or two once alcohol clears your system. Flare-ups or chronic skin issues: Rashes linked to rosacea, psoriasis, or heavy drinking can last days, weeks, or longer if triggers continue.
items.markdown:
- **Flushing and mild hives:** Often start within minutes to hours of drinking and may fade within a few hours to a day or two once alcohol clears your system.
- **Flare-ups or chronic skin issues:** Rashes linked to rosacea, psoriasis, or heavy drinking can last days, weeks, or longer if triggers continue.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX4znQizJvGclufLPGDRg0g9TMDQPY2dlCt5TFUbW5CmxzJaRFwbqfH-76z19Dxc589r0lx_VXXEOx387r5i2dZsZ0luO8mTEFMIY_TRwp_n-Pa3Wq0PU5zR7lH_OkY2-doK5hq9V9ayLfR3ED1T-OpM8GB9bhOjk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXRzgwYR56Yk7mULtXgsIPC1aNv1P6lCy9lm7Me63cbUfCEqwbd69cdkpbGBfHDVuI37yFcJ_EHRld_SibEYGPXhUQWD0bKEBo2l1qKH5nA123vz9zWfM1rEw5B0Xe4hrwwBdDezFpqlZROi6BCaqz-ZOsA44KVG5NzDo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_QX2c0JRG31Gi9ngc7w-SHdPoXrZ_0qVeE28CvJIz92TFBuGf3fNK9A_673Souf29xoLSagkUXl3ddWd2Z5lsDuo5o-wySLeB9Wvsd8gOTKrcmEt61FwUziJ1Yg56305Ra2RdX7E81_PNy8Qes82is7Of9EWDUpysjtAJUA)

items.title: Treatment and When to Get Help
items.text: At-home care: Stop drinking alcohol or avoid the specific beverage that triggered it. Cool compresses and over-the-counter antihistamines can help ease mild itching or hives after a reaction starts, though taking antihistamines before drinking is not recommended because it can mask warning signs and encourage heavier drinking. Emergency care: Seek urgent medical help immediately if a rash comes with trouble breathing, throat or tongue swelling, dizziness, severe vomiting, or a drop in blood pressure (signs of anaphylaxis). Medical evaluation: See a healthcare provider if rashes keep returning, don't clear up, or might be tied to a medication or underlying skin condition.
